name: Create the vault
description: Creates the vault folder and a random key kept in the OS keychain, or checks an existing vault against its key.
inputs: HUSH_KEY (optional key instead of the keychain)
outputs: recovery key, when run in a terminal

name: Restore the key on a new machine
description: Reads the recovery key from a hidden prompt and puts it in this machine's keychain.
inputs: recovery key typed at a hidden prompt

name: Show the recovery key
description: Prints the vault key in its recovery form, only in an interactive terminal.
inputs: key from the OS keychain or HUSH_KEY

name: Link a repo to a project
description: Writes hush.toml, creates the project in the vault and adds .env patterns to .gitignore.
inputs: project name, or the repo's folder name

name: List projects
description: Lists every project and the environments that hold secrets.
outputs: project names and environment names on stdout

name: Create a project
description: Creates an empty project in the vault without linking a repo.

name: Delete a project
description: Deletes a project and all its secrets after the user types its name in a terminal.
inputs: the same name typed at the prompt
outputs: project folder removed from the vault

name: Store a secret
description: Stores one value, read from a hidden prompt or from stdin, never from the command line.
inputs: value from a hidden prompt or stdin
outputs: encrypted environment file in the vault

name: Print a secret
description: Prints one value, with no trailing newline when piped.

name: List secret names
description: Lists the names in an environment, never the values.

name: Remove a secret
description: Removes one secret from an environment.

name: Import a .env file
description: Copies every variable in a .env file into the vault, refusing the whole file on any error.
outputs: encrypted environment file in the vault
count of new and replaced secrets

name: Export secrets
description: Prints every secret in an environment as dotenv lines or JSON.
outputs: every name and value on stdout

name: Run an app with its secrets
description: Starts a command with the environment's secrets added to its environment and passes its exit code back.
outputs: the command's own output and exit code

name: Choose the project and environment
description: Picks the vault project and environment for any command, overriding hush.toml and the dev default.
outputs: the command runs against that project and environment

name: Read production secrets
description: Reads an environment whose name starts with prod, which every reading command refuses without the flag.

name: Refuse to reveal values to an AI agent
description: When CLAUDECODE is set, refuses get, export, recovery-key and --allow-prod so values never reach the agent.
inputs: CLAUDECODE set to a non-empty value
outputs: an error and exit code 1, with no value printed
